# DdDesignReport

> Report library: templates are JSON (made in a drag-and-drop designer, or written by hand or by an LLM), and one Go core renders them with data to PDF, HTML, XLSX, XLS, CSV or ESC/POS receipt-printer commands, from Go, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, or any language over HTTP. MIT licensed.

## Rendering

- Go: `ddreport.Render(templateJSON, data, "pdf")` (`github.com/gvjavx/DdDesignReport`)
- Node.js: `require('ddreport').render(template, data, 'pdf')` (npm `ddreport`)
- Java/Kotlin: `DdReport.render(templateJson, dataJson, "pdf")` (Maven `io.github.gvjavx:ddreport`)
- Any language: `ddreport -serve 127.0.0.1:8080`, or the Docker image `ghcr.io/gvjavx/ddreport`, then `POST /render?format=pdf` with body `{"template": ..., "data": ...}` and header `Authorization: Bearer <DDREPORT_TOKEN>` when the server has a token. Errors come back as status 400 with the message as the body.
- Formats: `pdf`, `html`, `xlsx`, `xls`, `csv`, and `jrxml` (the template as a JasperReports 6 report), `escpos` (58/80 mm thermal receipt printers: send the bytes as they are) and `txt` (the same layout as plain text). For a receipt, make the page 164 pt (58 mm) or 226 pt (80 mm) wide; texts go in the character columns their boxes cover (32 or 48 a line, or `"textColumns"`), 11 pt and over prints double height. `ddreport -from-jrxml` reads a `.jrxml` back as a template.
- Embed the designer in a web app: npm `ddreport-designer`, `createDesigner(element, { template, onChange })`.

## Writing a template

- JSON Schema: `designer/template.schema.json` in the repository, also served by `ddreport -serve` at `/template.schema.json` and shipped as `ddreport-designer/template.schema.json`. Validate against it: unknown properties are mistakes. If you can run tools, `ddreport -mcp` is an MCP server whose `check_template` tool names misspelt properties and tries a render. Write `"version": 1` (the template format); a ddreport that reads an older format refuses the template instead of printing it wrongly.
- Sizes are in points (1/72 inch). A4 is `595 x 842`, Letter `612 x 792`. Element `x`, `y` are relative to their band, inside the page margins.
- Bands, top to bottom: `header` and `columnHeader` (every page), `groupHeader` (before each group), `detail` (once per data row), `groupFooter` (after each group), `summary` (once, after the last row), `footer` (every page). Grouping needs `groupBy`; up to six levels with `groupHeader2`/`groupFooter2` through `groupHeader6`/`groupFooter6`.
- Data rows are `data.rows` (or `dataKey`), or the data itself when it is a list. Other top-level fields are available everywhere: `{{customer.name}}`.
- Element types: `text`, `table`, `image`, `rect`, `line`, `chart`, `barcode`, `subreport`, `crosstab`.
- A pivot table is `{"type": "crosstab", "rowField": "region", "columnField": "month", "measure": "sum(total):0", "text": "Region"}`: a row per region, a column per month, each cell the measure over its rows, then a `Total` column and row (`totalLabel` renames them). It takes the table colour fields (`headerFill`, `footerFill`, `stripe`, `border`).
- Placeholders inside text and table cells: `{{field}}`, `{{qty * price:2}}` (`:N` = N decimals with separators), `{{sum(total)}}`, `{{avg(x)}}`, `{{min(x)}}`, `{{max(x)}}`, `{{count()}}`, `{{page}}`, `{{pages}}`, `{{now:dd/MM/yyyy}}`, `{{date:dd MMMM yyyy}}`, `{{if(paid, 'PAID', 'DUE')}}`, `{{upper(x)}}`, `{{round(x, 2)}}`, `{{terbilang(total)}}` (Indonesian words), `{{index}}` (row number). Aggregates cover the group in group and detail bands, all rows elsewhere. Field names with dashes go in brackets inside expressions: `{{[unit-price] * qty}}`.
- A list inside a row (order items) is a table with `"data": "items"`: its first row (`"header": true`) and last row (`"footer": true`) print once, the rows between repeat per item.
- Colours are `#rrggbb`, or an expression: `"color": "{{if(total < 0, '#dc2626', '#000000')}}"`.
- `showIf` hides an element when its condition is false: `"showIf": "discount > 0"`.
- `grow: true` on a text or table lets the band grow with its content instead of clipping it; long tables continue on the next page with their header row repeated.
- Bold parts of a text: `Total <b>{{sum(total):2}}</b>`. Only `<b>`, `<i>`, `<u>` are markup.
- `"pdfA": true` makes the PDF PDF/A-2b (fonts embedded; Helvetica, Times and Courier print as Roboto and Lora).
- Indonesian number style: `"thousands": ".", "decimal": ","`; Indonesian dates: `"locale": "id"`.

## Example

An invoice with its items, a total and a red balance when it is negative. This example is checked by the library's tests: it validates against the schema and renders.

```json
{
  "template": {
    "version": 1,
    "page": { "width": 595, "height": 842, "margin": 40 },
    "thousands": ".", "decimal": ",", "locale": "id",
    "bands": {
      "header": { "height": 60, "elements": [
        { "type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 300, "h": 24, "text": "INVOICE {{number}}", "fontSize": 18, "bold": true },
        { "type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 28, "w": 300, "h": 14, "text": "{{customer.name}} · {{date:dd MMMM yyyy}}" },
        { "type": "barcode", "x": 455, "y": 0, "w": 60, "h": 60, "text": "{{number}}" }
      ] },
      "summary": { "height": 110, "elements": [
        { "type": "table", "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 515, "h": 60, "data": "items", "header": true, "footer": true,
          "border": 0.5, "grow": true, "headerFill": "#1e3a8a", "headerColor": "#ffffff", "stripe": "#f1f5f9",
          "cols": [1, 6, 2, 3], "aligns": ["center", "left", "right", "right"],
          "cells": [
            ["No", "Item", "Qty", "Amount"],
            ["{{index}}", "{{name}}", "{{qty}}", "{{qty * price:0}}"],
            ["", "Total", "{{sum(qty)}}", "{{sum(qty * price):0}}"]
          ] },
        { "type": "text", "x": 315, "y": 70, "w": 200, "h": 14, "align": "right",
          "text": "Balance: <b>{{paid - total:0}}</b>", "color": "{{if(paid < total, '#dc2626', '#16a34a')}}" }
      ] },
      "footer": { "height": 20, "elements": [
        { "type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 4, "w": 515, "h": 12, "align": "right", "fontSize": 8, "text": "Page {{page}} of {{pages}}" }
      ] }
    }
  },
  "data": {
    "number": "INV-001", "date": "2026-10-26", "customer": { "name": "Toko Maju" }, "total": 54000, "paid": 50000,
    "items": [ { "name": "Kopi", "qty": 2, "price": 18000 }, { "name": "Gula", "qty": 3, "price": 6000 } ]
  }
}
```

## More

- Full documentation (Indonesian): README.md in https://github.com/gvjavx/DdDesignReport
- Ready-made templates with sample data: `designer/templates/*.json` (invoice, sales report, receipt, payslip, certificate, letter, stock list, labels, kuitansi, surat jalan, rapor, attendance list, profit and loss)
